title: Oscar and the Atlas
author: Sebastian Eriksen
blurb: Coral Dravenmoor, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
